_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Inertia (Mass Properties) Report for Aircraft
summary: The Inertia (Mass Properties) Report for Aircraft provides up-to-date information to track deleterious trends, support engineering activities, and provide safety of flight information to the field.
use_relationship:
The Inertia (Mass Properties) Report for Aircraft provides up-to-date information required to maintain cognizance of deleterious trends which may require program office action, provide data for use by various engineering activities, and provide safety of flight information to the field.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) interrelates with DI-MGMT-81452, Mass Properties Control and Management Process Report.
b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information, for the data deliverable resulting from the work tasks described in the contract.
c. DI-MGMT-81504A supersedes DI-MGMT-81504.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Inertial Loads Report shall specify the calculated inertia loads, including results of weight and balance analyses, moments of inertia, and distribution of inertia loads, shears, and moments for unit linear and angular accelerations. The data in this report shall correspond to an Estimated, Calculated, or Actual Weight Report. Inertia Loads Report shall include:

children.title: Contract number, aircraft designation, acquisition activity and contractor identification or serial numbers, as appropriate, of the aircraft for which the data in the report is considered to be representative.
Identification of the weight report with which the inertia data is identified.
A table summarizing the weight, center of gravity (c.g.) and moment of inertia data for weight empty and all weight conditions covered in the report identified in b. above.
Dimensional data suitability illustrated, locating the aircraft axes (references and principle) and Mean Aerodynamic Chord (MAC).
Detailed data used for flutter analysis, flying quality analysis, and other analysis.
children.content: This may be panel point data.
